disposition_reason: Reports 21 elements including arsenic, cadmium and lead by ICP-MS on a fresh-weight basis in 53 raw pork leg, loin and tenderloin samples from Transylvania, Romania.

study.design: retail and producer survey by cut
study.market: local producers and supermarkets in Transylvania, Romania
lod: not reported; calibration range 0.005-0.5 µg/L for As, Cd, Pb
study.qa: standard reference materials NCS ZC85006 and NCS ZC73016 used to check accuracy; recoveries not printed

Arsenic is total arsenic (ICP-MS, no speciation).
